crime: A girl often sat beside {WITCH_NAME} as she reread messages and checked her belongings before leaving, waiting without rushing her. {WITCH_NAME} came to trust the girl and explained the habit: the sole recipient of a desperate private plea had once forwarded it to others, who mocked her. At midday, the girl sat against the center of a lounge sofa, repeated an exact private detail from that plea to several girls, and imitated {WITCH_NAME}'s rereading. The girl announced that she would perform it again from the same seat that evening.

That evening, the girl asked a friend to wait directly outside the lounge while the girl practiced alone. The friend saw the otherwise empty room and watched the girl settle against the middle of the same sofa. {WITCH_NAME} remained in the dining hall with several other girls. Without anyone passing the friend at the door, the snap of a crossbow release and a heavy impact came from inside.

The friend entered and found the girl dead. A bolt had pierced the sofa back and the center of the girl's back before entering her heart. The lounge crossbow was hidden behind the sofa and aimed at the seat, but no cord, timer, or other trigger device was attached. Beneath its cocking hook, a narrow strip of {WITCH_NAME}'s distinctive prison-uniform sleeve matched a fresh tear in the cuff.

The door watch ruled out anyone firing inside, and the absence of an attached mechanism ruled out an ordinary remote release. The dining-hall witnesses placed her there when the crossbow fired, while the cloth showed that {WITCH_NAME} had cocked and positioned it. During afternoon free time, she had used her own hand to cock the unloaded crossbow and pull its trigger twice along the same path. This stored the trigger's movement. She then cocked and loaded the crossbow and concealed it behind the sofa. At a time she chose later that evening, she used Stored Motion from the dining hall, without touching the crossbow, to replay the trigger's path once. The magic worked at any distance inside the prison, and that replay consumed the stored movement. The crossbow fired through the sofa into the girl's heart and killed her.
fields.epitaph: Two matching answers still left the third free to betray her.
execution: A broad iron blade hung above her bare neck while restraints held her beneath it.

The blade fell once, stopped just short of her neck, and rose. It repeated the full drop and stop a second time, then rose again. On the third fall, it did not stop. The iron edge passed through her neck, severed her head, and killed her immediately.

magic.name: Stored Motion
magic.text: She can store an object's movement and replay it later.
